reviews.comment: Tanzir is an awesome professor. The material for sure wasn't the easiest and the programming assignments definitely took some time, but everything was very manageable. He also pushed back assignments if the class needed it. While I didn't attend every lecture, as the lectures slides are pretty great, his lectures are definitely something to attend.

Great professor. Cares about your understanding in the class more than the grade you will get and this will usually result in you getting a better grade. Takes his time to answer any additonal questions and is incredibly thorough in lectures. Never had a hard time. Quizzes and labs, but can be done with ease and quickly if you watch the lectures.

Tanzir is a very caring professor and hands down has the most useful office hours i have experienced. While he may not have the most engaging lectures he can sometimes be quite funny. The class is project based and the lectures follow along with them. 7 projects where the last replaces, 2 exams, 6 quizzes were the last replaces and attendance grade

Tanzir is one of the best professors I have ever taken. He makes lectures interesting and is very fair as far as grading goes. He will answer questions asked online very quickly and make it a priority to help students out. The class isn't easy, but Tanzir does a good job of making it reasonable. You won't regret showing up to lectures.
